g.text: 2. Plan symbol roles - stroke and fill language (24 px/cell)
3. State overlays on wall / room / object - color row, grayscale row
Invalid = short dash + hatch; locked = dotted + light hatch; generated = long dash, no fill. Structure carries the state - color is reinforcement only.
4. Two-storey plan - active storey solid, lower ghost, roof overhead
exterior heavy / partitions medium / doors: open poses + closed / windows glazed
stair treads + up arrow / lower storey ghosted / roof outline + ridge dashed overhead
5. Terrain plan - contours, plateau, road, ditch, bridge, bands, mask
minor/major contours by weight - plateau mesa - road double edge - ditch dark pair
bridge deck + abutments where road crosses ditch - dashed region mask - band fills
6. Reserved - reference only, absent from production enums
asset thumbnail frame: mesh render lives here
missing asset: dashed frame + slash, no text
selected asset: accent border + corner check
category badge: corner chip reuses the family glyph
